fact: The director general of the Institut national de la statistique said on 5 June 2026 that the Open Data Portal is at work and anyone can access and download data from it in Excel, PDF and Word formats.
The SYNA-MNV programme of Congo's forest economy ministry publishes five datasets for download on its open data page, the newest dated 2024.
The SYNA-MNV programme states its datasets are published under an open licence, with reuse requiring the credit 'Source : SYNA-MNV - Republique du Congo'.
